sources.title: India’s Transgender Rights Bill a Huge Setback | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch news item (26 March 2026) describing the amendment to India's 2019 Transgender Persons Act as 'a huge setback': the change removes self-identification from legal recognition. National-level item, not state-specific; page text was largely site navigation at fetch time, substance from the headline/title.

sources.title: Transgender Bill: India parliament passes amendment to redefine transgender identity amid protests
sources.claim_summary: BBC News (26 March 2026): India's parliament passed the controversial bill amending the 2019 Transgender Persons Act - recognition narrowed to biological or physical traits, self-identification removed, medical-board certification made mandatory for gender-affirming surgery; presidential assent pending; nationwide protests by the LGBTQ community and opposition, with a Supreme Court advisory panel asking the government to withdraw it. National-level, not state-specific.

Times of India (18 August 2024): a group of trans women heading to a protest filed an FIR alleging a railway protection force constable groped one of them at a metro station under the pretext of a 'gender check', making lewd remarks; the metro operator and force denied the allegations and filed a counter-FIR against the group. Incident occurred in Kolkata - not in this state; retained in this record's source list as contextual evidence of gender-based harassment by security personnel.
